scope: Stable Jido 2.4 library shutdown and effect durability only; not CMS, V3 or deployment acceptance.

direct_program.program:
defmodule NativeStopProgramHost do
  @behaviour OhMyJido.Host
  def authorize(_context, :exec, _effect, _opts), do: :ok
  def authorize(context, capability, effect, opts), do: OhMyJido.Host.Local.authorize(context, capability, effect, opts)
  defdelegate credentials(context, account, opts), to: OhMyJido.Host.Local
  defdelegate invoke(context, capability, request, opts), to: OhMyJido.Host.Local
  def question(_context, _question, _opts), do: :pending
end
root = System.fetch_env!("OMJ_STOP_PROGRAM_ROOT")
{:ok, runtime} = OhMyJido.Runtime.start_link(name: NativeStopProgram, tools: [OhMyJido.Tools.Shell], max_processes: 1)
{:ok, session} = OhMyJido.start_session(NativeStopProgram, workspace: root, permissions: [:exec], host: {NativeStopProgramHost, []})
try do
  command = "printf 'once\\n' > writes; printf '%s\\n' \"$$\" > leader; sleep 30 & printf '%s\\n' \"$!\" > child; wait"
  task = Task.async(fn -> OhMyJido.execute_tool(session, "shell", %{executable: System.find_executable("sh"), args: ["-c", command], timeout_ms: 20_000}) end)
  ready = fn -> Enum.all?(["leader", "child"], fn name -> case File.read(Path.join(root, name)) do {:ok, bytes} -> String.trim(bytes) != ""; _ -> false end end) end
  Enum.reduce_while(1..500, nil, fn _, _ -> if ready.(), do: {:halt, :ready}, else: (Process.sleep(10); {:cont, nil}) end)
  true = ready.()
  pids = Enum.map(["leader", "child"], fn name -> root |> Path.join(name) |> File.read!() |> String.trim() |> String.to_integer() end)
  :ok = OhMyJido.stop_session(session)
  _tool_result = Task.await(task, 10_000)
  stopped = Enum.all?(pids, fn pid -> case OhMyJido.Process.capture_identity(pid) do {:ok, %{state: state}} -> state in ["Z", "X"]; {:error, reason} -> reason in [:enoent, :esrch] end end)
  true = stopped
  true = is_nil(GenServer.whereis(OhMyJido.Runtime.via(session)))
  true = File.read!(Path.join(root, "writes")) == "once\n"
  IO.puts(JSON.encode!(%{stop_confirmed: true, actual_shell_entered: true, leader_and_child_stopped: stopped, session_terminated: true, single_write_retained: true}))
after
  Supervisor.stop(runtime)
end
direct_program.temporary_workspace_environment: OMJ_STOP_PROGRAM_ROOT points to a freshly created disposable directory.

timeout_regression.behavior: A real native Action appends once before its actual enclosing deadline. The journal must remain uncertain across checkpoint/restore, and reused effect identity must reject before a second append.

limits: Successful stop confirms registered native effects/resources and session services, not rollback or an OS sandbox.
Actor/controller death and bare unregister do not confirm resource cleanup. Unknown cleanup leaves supervised admission sealed.
Density model latency is scripted; no provider throughput or performance improvement is claimed.
CMS, genuine native V3, public production release and Fly effects have separate pending gates.
